examples.arabic: مشمش كانت مستنياهم عند باب الشقة.
examples.english: Meshmesh was waiting for them at the apartment door.
examples.transliteration: Meshmesh kanet mestanyahom 3and bab el sha2qa.

examples.arabic: أنا بفتح الباب وهما بيدخلوا؛ الشقة بتاعتي صغيرة بس حلوة.
examples.english: I open the door and they enter; my apartment is small but nice.
examples.transliteration: Ana bafta7 el bab w homa byedkholo; el sha22a beta3ty soghayyara bas 7elwa.

examples.english: They knocked on the door quietly.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: الظهر، أصحابي خبطوا على الباب وطلبوا مني أخرج.
examples.english: In the afternoon, my friends knocked on the door and asked me to go out.
examples.transliteration: el dohr, ashabiy khabato ala el bab wa talabo meny akhrog.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.english: Ahmed is in front of the house and the door is closed.
examples.transliteration: ahmed oddam el beit wa el baab makfool

examples.arabic: هو كان بيشرب قهوة قدام الباب
examples.english: He was drinking coffee in front of the door.
examples.transliteration: howa kan beyishrab ahwa oddam elbab
